IncidentBot: PAGER 2026-03-16T01:15Z — dedicated-controlplane-auth — elevated 401/403 for dedicated customers :rotating_light:

Elena (oncall): I got paged, looking into it. seeing spikes of 401/403 from auth-proxy on dedicated-controlplane in us-east-1. first anomalies at ~01:12Z.

Maya (support): multiple enterprise tenants reporting failed model loads and 401s. acme-corp has >50 failed model load ops. logging their SLA contact.

Raj S: checking auth-proxy and key-rotation. The service-account key-rotation job ran at 01:10Z but pods report signature-mismatch. suspicious that new secret didn't propagate to control-plane pods. Trying restarting leader to force secret reload.

Elena (oncall): mitigations to run now: 1) restart control-plane leader(s) in us-east-1 2) if that doesn't clear, fail impacted tenants to dedicated-fallback-hostpool 3) open incident ticket and notify accounts. I'll coordinate restarts.

Raj S: restarted leader pod at 01:22Z. Logs show secret reload and token validation succeeding again. Observed drop in 401s after 01:24Z as caches refreshed.

IncidentBot: Action logged — restart by Raj S at 2026-03-16T01:22Z

Maya (support): customer impact summary: acme-corp impacted from 01:12Z to ~01:25Z with transient model load errors. Support ticket INC-2026-89 created and account team notified. No data loss, billing unaffected.

Elena (oncall): status update: 401 rates back near baseline by 01:26Z. Current hypothesis: key-rotation job updated k8s secret but the control-plane pods did not pick up the new secret due to an RBAC/propagation regression in last deploy.

Raj S: confirming: the rotate job wrote secret "dedicated-auth-key-v3" at 01:10Z; the secret watcher failed to trigger reload because clusterRole binding was missing in the canary deploy. Rolling back that RBAC change in canary now and will push fix after postmortem.

Elena (oncall): follow-ups and owners: 1) infra-deploy: audit the deploy that removed watcher RBAC 2) infra-sre: add post-rotate verification step to rotate job (owner: Raj S) 3) infra-ci: add canary test that validates secret hash matches active pod environment within 2m (owner: Raj S) 4) alerting: add rule auth-secret-mismatch (owner: Elena).

Raj S: taking primary for the next 3h. I'll set a temporary alert: auth-401-rate > 0.3% for 5m OR auth-error-rate increase by factor >3. I'll also create a small dashboard filter for us-east-1 control-plane traffic and post link here.

Maya (support): I'll keep the customer ticket updated, attach timeline to INC-2026-89 and start the customer-facing summary.

Elena (oncall): handoff checklist: primary=Raj S, secondary=Elena. Monitor p95 latency for control-plane API and auth 401/403 rates. Runbook pointer: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/dedicated-controlplane-auth (internal).

Raj S: noted. I'll document timeline and own the post-incident action items. If we see repeat 401s I'll fail traffic to the dedicated-fallback-hostpool and page SRE.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-89 status changed to 'monitoring' by Raj S at 2026-03-16T01:31Z

Elena (oncall): leaving handoff. last_message_ts=5100012405. Thanks team, ping primary if anything spikes. :wave:

OpsRelayer: scheduled metrics snapshot to post at 2026-03-16T01:40Z for owner Raj S (automated).

(threads ends)
